changelog.body:
HyperControl 1.0.3

- Added an independent “swap brightness and volume” setting.
- Horizontal mode now identifies brightness and volume by their bound controller, so recycled views keep the selected order.
- Redesigned the Material 3 settings screen for edge-to-edge and display-cutout safe insets.
- Added a button linking to the GitHub project.

Validation:
- `:app:assembleRelease`
- `:app:lintRelease`
- Settings UI verified on NX667J / HyperOS with safe top and bottom insets.

SHA-256: `7261D7AEE8239BF7F2C794EE5CC8A3E393EE6732C8E66E00B72B532F211D6232`

HyperControl 1.0.2

Bug fix:
- Horizontal brightness and media-volume bars now keep the native VerticalSeekBar touch and listener pipeline. Dragging the bars updates the real system brightness and media volume instead of only changing the painted progress state.
- Horizontal gesture arbitration now selects the slider only for horizontal movement.

Validation:
- `:app:assembleRelease`
- `:app:lintRelease`
- On Nubia NX667J / HyperOS Android 14 / LSPosed API 102, brightness changed 255 -> 8 and media volume changed 10 -> 15 by swiping the controls.

SHA-256: `392795D40BEC45433C86F3830B315747D3F17359456419B3869AC30402B07FB1`

HyperControl 1.0.1

- Libxposed API 102 module for HyperOS Control Center.
- Swaps media and brightness/volume controls.
- Horizontal brightness and volume bars with left-aligned icons.

Source: https://github.com/Orynnx/HyperControl

readme:
# HyperControl

HyperControl is a libxposed API 102 module for Xiaomi HyperOS Control Center.

Features:

- Swap the media playback block with the brightness and volume controls.
- Render brightness and volume as horizontal controls with left-aligned icons.
- Material 3 settings screen and verified SystemUI restart handling.

Source code and documentation: https://github.com/Orynnx/HyperControl

The release was built with `:app:assembleRelease` and `:app:lintRelease`, and verified on Nubia NX667J / HyperOS Android 14 / LSPosed API 102.
